covers: the system session_title_changed event a rename_session control request emits ahead of its control_response, before the first turn and after one (ark3/agentpane#85)
prompt: control_requests get_settings, then rename_session "probe name pre-turn", 5s quiet, the user prompt "Reply with the single word ok." to its result, 2s quiet, rename_session "probe name after turn", 5s quiet, the same prompt again to its result, 2s quiet, then stdin closed; no initialize
invocation: claude -p --input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-partial-messages --model haiku --session-id <session_id>, run directly with no sbox, against the session's own ~/.claude
follow_on_runs: The same session respawned on the same flags with --resume <session_id> in place of --session-id, and again with --resume <session_id> --resume-session-at <first assistant uuid> --fork-session --session-id <new id>, each sent only get_settings and no prompt (2026-11-22T06:48-05:00). Each wrote a session_title_changed naming "probe name after turn" unprompted, before the get_settings reply: on the resume under the stored session_id, at 942ms and 8686ms in two runs; on the fork under the new id, at 993ms and 2927ms in two runs. Not recorded as fixtures.
